about: 관리 > 일용근로 급여계산/대장(E020139) — 일용근로 사원 둘(일근무 150,000 · 200,000)이 2091/10 에 이틀씩 근무입력돼 있을 때, 대장 신규 → 근무기록확정 [근무기록] 으로 2 · 2 를 불러 저장 → 전체계산 → 급여대장: 지급총액 700,000 · 소득세 2,700 · 지방소득세 270 · 실지급액 697,030. 세금은 원본 계산식처럼 사원 [급여지급사항] 월정공제 그대로(B 만 2,700 · 270 을 적어 두었다 — A 는 비어 0, 원본 150,000 × 2 → 세금 0 과 같다). 대장을 지우고 시험 자료를 정리한다.

shots.name: 대장 신규 → 근무기록확정 → 전체계산 → 급여대장 → 삭제
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const mk=async(n,w)=>(await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:n,foreigner:false,employmentInsurance:true,pensionAuto:false,healthAuto:false,dailyWage:w})})).json());const a=await mk('QA관리-일용A',150000);const b=await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:'QA관리-일용B',foreigner:false,employmentInsurance:true,pensionAuto:false,healthAuto:false,dailyWage:200000,fixedIncomeTax:2700,fixedLocalTax:270})})).json();const s=await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({slipDate:'2091-10-05',lines:[{workDate:'2091-10-05',workerId:a.id,quantity:2},{workDate:'2091-10-06',workerId:b.id,quantity:2}]})})).json();sessionStorage.setItem('qaDp',JSON.stringify({a:a.id,b:b.id,slip:s.slipDate+'/'+s.slipNo}));return true})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const q=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qaDp'));const r1=await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries/'+q.slip,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});const r2=await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers/'+q.a,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});const r3=await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers/'+q.b,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});sessionStorage.setItem('qaDpClean',String(r1.ok&&r2.ok&&r3.ok));return true})()
